senses.definition_en: topless (exposing one's bare chest)

examples.english: We don't customarily go topless nor do we like sunbathing surrounded by people who do practise it, and every year we find it more difficult to find a place to our liking.
examples.ref: 2013 August 16, Laura Campmany, “¿Si hay playas nudistas, por qué no hay playas para toples?”, in El Periodico:
examples.text: Nosotros no tenemos la costumbre de hacer toples ni nos gusta tomar el sol rodeados de gente que lo practique, y cada año nos cuesta más encontrar un sitio de nuestro agrado.
examples.translation: We don't customarily go topless nor do we like sunbathing surrounded by people who do practise it, and every year we find it more difficult to find a place to our liking.

examples.english: "A red line has been crossed", warned the spokespersons of the royal household upon seeing the first topless images of Princess Kate.
examples.ref: 2012 September 17, “La ‘reina’ Kate, desnuda también en Italia”, in El Pais:
examples.text: "Se ha cruzado la línea roja", advirtieron los portavoces de la casa real británica al ver las primeras imágenes en toples de Catalina.
examples.translation: "A red line has been crossed", warned the spokespersons of the royal household upon seeing the first topless images of Princess Kate.

examples.english: He breathed anxiously when he left and swam towards the shore, got to his feet and then happened to see that he found himself on a beach in the Caribbean full of topless mulatto women.
examples.ref: 2007, Luis Artigue, Las perlas del loco, page 62:
examples.text: Respiró con ansia al salir y nadó hacia la orilla, se puso en pie y entonces acertó a ver que se encontraba en una playa del Caribe llena de mulatas en toples.
examples.translation: He breathed anxiously when he left and swam towards the shore, got to his feet and then happened to see that he found himself on a beach in the Caribbean full of topless mulatto women.

glosses: topless (exposing one's bare chest)
